# Enhancement & Equipment Rules Requirements Quality Checklist: Equipment & +0..+10 Weapon Enhancement

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ chính xác, tính công bằng và tính toàn vẹn giao dịch cho hệ thống 10 ô trang bị, 6 bộ set, độ bền/sửa chữa/tách đồ và cường hóa chắc chắn `+0 → +10` (`007-equipment-enhancement`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Equipment Loadout & Set Bonus Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all 10 equipment slots (`MAIN_HAND`, `OFF_HAND`, `HELMET`, `CHEST_ARMOR`, `GLOVES`, `BOOTS`, `RING_1`, `RING_2`, `NECKLACE`, `ACCESSORY`) and their validation rules (ownership, `levelReq`, `allowedClasses`, two-handed `OFF_HAND` rule, no duplicate ring instance) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all 6 canonical equipment sets (`set_greenhaven_novice` through `set_abyssal_sovereign`) with 2-piece and 4-piece activation thresholds and automatic stat recalculation clearly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are bag-full unequip refusal and active-hero weapon-incompatibility handling explicitly specified to prevent accidental item loss? [Edge Case, Spec §US1, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Deterministic `+0 → +10` Weapon Enhancement Rules

- [ ] CHK004 Are the non-negotiable MVP enhancement guarantees (`100%` success rate, `0%` break risk, `0%` downgrade risk, strict `+10` hard cap) consistently aligned with Constitution Principle VI and `docs/balancing/weapon-upgrade-costs.csv`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Constitution §VI]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the exact `bld_blacksmith` level gates (Lv 1: `+1..+3`, Lv 2: `+4..+6`, Lv 3: `+7..+8`, Lv 4: `+9..+10`) and `bld_storage >= Lv 2` automatic material pull explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the exact `+5` (`Weapon Glow I`, `+3% Crit Rate`) and `+10` (`Radiant Aura II`, `+8% Boss Poise Damage`, `+5% Skill Scaling`) milestone perks unambiguously quantified and bounded by combat hard caps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Durability, Repair, Dismantle & Socketing Roadmap Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are durability depletion (`0..durabilityMax`), the non-destructive `WORN` state (`50%` base stats at `durability = 0`), field repair (`csm_repair_kit` `+50%`), and Blacksmith full repair (`100%` with `0%/10%/20%/30%` Lv 1–4 discount) unambiguously defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK008 Are dismantling safeguards (blocking equipped items, requiring confirmation for `>= +1` or `RARE+` items, verifying bag space for returned materials, `30%–50%` salvage return) completely stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the M2+ socketing roadmap scope clearly bounded (preserving `0..2` `sockets` field on item instances while returning a clean roadmap-locked status in MVP)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Transaction Atomicity, Anti-Cheat & Honesty

- [ ] CHK010 Does the enhancement transaction requirement explicitly mandate a single atomic local-JSON WAL commit updating character, inventory, `upgrade-history-<charId>.json`, and `currency-ledger-YYYY-MM.json` with sorted locks and `idempotencyKey`? [Security, Spec §FR-006, Constitution §I, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK011 Are concurrent enhancement spam and mid-WAL crash recovery scenarios clearly measurable with `0` item duplication and `100%` ledger reconciliation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Are transaction latency goals (`p95 < 20 ms`) and estimated grind durations transparently marked `proposed / unverified`? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §VIII]

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
